correctness.rationale: The complement equivalence and radius-four local condition are proved from the definitions. The all-order lower bound follows from exact Bellman–Ford potentials on a fully enumerated 233-state, 403-edge graph, where each accepted word has cost 7|T|-2n; sink distance is zero. Every residue class has a seven-periodic constructed extremizer with finite-factor proof of all-order admissibility. Original graph-definition tests across 16,380 subsets corroborate, but do not replace, these proofs.
